_meta.schema: snippet: id, title, trap (the mistake this block avoids), yaml, requires (optional: collection dependency beyond ansible-core), source, verified

snippets.title: Config file + conditional restart (the handler idiom)
snippets.trap: Restarting a service on every run (unnecessary outages) or never (config deployed but not loaded).
snippets.yaml:
- name: Deploy sshd configuration
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: sshd_config.j2
    dest: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: '0600'
    validate: /usr/sbin/sshd -t -f %s
  notify: Restart sshd

# in the play's handlers: section
- name: Restart sshd
  ansible.builtin.systemd_service:
    name: sshd
    state: restarted

snippets.title: Never deploy an invalid config: validate:
snippets.trap: Pushing a broken sshd/sudoers/httpd config that locks you out or downs the service — validate: runs the daemon's own checker against the NEW file before it replaces the old one.
snippets.yaml:
- name: Deploy sudoers drop-in (validated)
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    src: 99-automation
    dest: /etc/sudoers.d/99-automation
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: '0440'
    validate: /usr/sbin/visudo -cf %s

snippets.title: Idempotent user with SSH key
snippets.trap: usermod -G destroying group membership; hand-managed authorized_keys with wrong perms.
snippets.yaml:
- name: Ensure automation user exists
  ansible.builtin.user:
    name: svc_ansible
    groups: wheel
    append: true          # the -aG of Ansible: never drop existing groups
    shell: /bin/bash

- name: Ensure SSH key is authorized
  ansible.posix.authorized_key:
    user: svc_ansible
    key: "{{ lookup('file', 'files/svc_ansible.pub') }}"
    state: present
snippets.requires: ansible.posix collection — not part of ansible-core; see 'Install a collection offline' in Commands if the box lacks it

snippets.title: firewalld: permanent AND immediate
snippets.trap: The runtime-vs-permanent split — a rule that works until reload, or is saved but not active.
snippets.yaml:
- name: Open HTTPS, now and after reboot
  ansible.posix.firewalld:
    service: https
    state: enabled
    permanent: true
    immediate: true       # both flags, every time — the module's version of the add+reload idiom
snippets.requires: ansible.posix collection — not part of ansible-core; see 'Install a collection offline' in Commands if the box lacks it

snippets.title: command with idempotence guards
snippets.trap: Bare command/shell tasks re-run every play and lie to --check mode; creates: makes them skip when the work is done.
snippets.yaml:
- name: Initialize the thing exactly once
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: /usr/local/bin/initialize --datadir /var/lib/thing
    creates: /var/lib/thing/.initialized   # exists => task skips, stays green
  register: init_result
  changed_when: init_result.rc == 0

snippets.title: block / rescue / always — try-catch for tasks
snippets.trap: A failed mid-play task leaving a host half-configured with no cleanup and no clear signal.
snippets.yaml:
- name: Apply risky change with rollback
  block:
    - name: Take pre-change backup
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: /etc/app/app.conf
        dest: /etc/app/app.conf.pre
        remote_src: true
    - name: Deploy new config
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: app.conf.j2
        dest: /etc/app/app.conf
      notify: Restart app
  rescue:
    - name: Roll back config
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: /etc/app/app.conf.pre
        dest: /etc/app/app.conf
        remote_src: true
    - name: Fail loudly after rollback
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: 'Deploy failed on {{ inventory_hostname }} — rolled back.'
  always:
    - name: Record attempt in ops log
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /var/log/ops-changes.log
        line: '{{ ansible_date_time.iso8601 }} app.conf deploy attempt'
        create: true

snippets.title: Rolling update with a canary batch
snippets.trap: Pushing a bad change to the whole fleet at once; serial + max_fail_percentage stops the bleeding automatically.
snippets.yaml:
- name: Roll out web tier carefully
  hosts: webservers
  serial:
    - 1              # canary: one host first
    - '25%'          # then a quarter at a time
  max_fail_percentage: 0   # any failure halts the rollout
  tasks:
    - name: ...your change...
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: placeholder

snippets.title: Reboot and wait for the host to return
snippets.trap: Rebooting with shell 'reboot' kills the connection and fails the play; the reboot module handles the round trip. And 'systemctl is-system-running' alone exits non-zero on 'degraded' (any failed unit) — it would fail hosts that are up and healthy enough to SSH.
snippets.yaml:
- name: Reboot and wait
  ansible.builtin.reboot:
    msg: 'Patching reboot — back in a few minutes'
    reboot_timeout: 600
    # accept running OR degraded; a pre-existing failed unit must not fail the reboot.
    # chase degraded afterwards: systemctl list-units --failed
    test_command: systemctl is-system-running | grep -qE '^(running|degraded)$'
snippets.source: ansible-doc reboot (core 2.21.1); systemd.special is-system-running exit codes

snippets.title: Security patch cycle with report
snippets.trap: Blind 'dnf update everything' with no record of what changed and no reboot logic.
snippets.yaml:
- name: Apply security errata only
  ansible.builtin.dnf:
    name: '*'
    security: true
    state: latest
  register: patch_result

- name: Show what changed
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    var: patch_result.results

- name: Reboot if kernel was updated
  ansible.builtin.reboot:
    reboot_timeout: 600
  when: patch_result.changed and (patch_result.results | select('search', 'kernel') | list | length > 0)

snippets.title: Surgical config line with backup
snippets.trap: lineinfile without regexp appends duplicates forever; without backup you can't see what you replaced.
snippets.yaml:
- name: Enforce SSH MaxAuthTries
  ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
    path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
    regexp: '^#?MaxAuthTries'
    line: 'MaxAuthTries 4'
    backup: true
    validate: /usr/sbin/sshd -t -f %s
  notify: Restart sshd
